summary: Every course must be taken for a letter grade when the instructor offers one, toward the 100 units the major needs. The audit checks 24 units of math, 26 units of science (general chemistry is CHEM 31A with 31B, or CHEM 31E), BIOE 131 for both Technology in Society and WIM, the engineering fundamentals core, the Bioengineering core (BIOE 141A and 141B are also the capstone), and three depth electives for 8 units; otherwise a course counts toward one requirement only. You move in your Fundamentals elective from the School of Engineering list and any petitioned depth elective, and check the 2.0 Fundamentals and Depth GPA by hand. Honors needs 9 letter-graded units of BIOE 191X over two quarters, a 3.5 GPA, the thesis and the poster fair.

program.why: Grading: "All courses taken for the major must be taken for a letter grade if the instructor offers that option."

RkyaiMXy.why: "CHEM 31A and B together fulfill the first part of the chemistry requirement; they are considered one course even though they are given over two quarters." Either both of CHEM 31A and 31B, or CHEM 31E.

E0kMjP6R.why: "Students must complete at least one course from the School of Engineering's approved Engineering Fundamentals list for 2026-27. The list is available in the Engineering Fundamentals subsection within the Engineering-BS School Requirements." The list is not in this program's data; the student moves the course in. "Only one CS class may count toward Fundamentals requirement" spans this rule and the core's CS 106A/B and is checked by hand.

0PWd1QRl.why: The Bulletin's structured rule for Depth Electives is "completeVariableCoursesAndVariableCredits" with minCourses 3 and minCredits 8, which the converter ignores (it read units=3 from "Any petitioned Depth Elective must be taken for at least 3 units"). The one petitioned course a student may request is moved in by hand.

8K07QxCv.why: "Complete at least two quarters of research with a minimum of nine units of [BIOE 191X] Out-of-Department Advanced Research Laboratory in Bioengineering for a letter grade; up to three units may be used towards the bioengineering depth elective requirements." Nine letter-graded units over at least two enrollments. Both parts share, so BIOE 191X units a student moves into Depth Electives (up to three, by hand) still count toward the nine.
